property_summary: For any admissible deposit amount sent to C, calling withdrawAll as the owner drains the entire contract balance so address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant withdraws 0, leaving balance == amount. (Note: the owner must be an EOA, since C pays the owner via `transfer`, which would revert if the owner were the test contract — hence the prank-deployed owner.)
change_summary: Withdraw 0 instead of the full contract balance.
